title: Agentic AI in Healthcare & Medicine: A Seven-Dimensional Taxonomy for Empirical Evaluation of LLM-based Agents

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Healthcare Equity Bias (Age, Gender/Sex, Race, Language, Disability, Socioeconomic)
bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review and empirical evaluation of 49 LLM-based healthcare agents using a taxonomy rubric to determine if the studies implement subgroup bias analyses, use fairness metrics, and conduct demographic auditing across clinically salient cohorts.
